abstract: OBJECTIVE: The purpose of this study was to differentiate ruptured from unruptured mediastinal teratomas using CT. MATERIALS AND METHODS; CT findings in 17 cases of surgically resected mediastinal teratomas were reviewed retrospectively. Preoperative rupture was found in seven patients during surgery. We compared the clinical symptoms and CT findings of ruptured tumors with those of unruptured tumors. On CT, we evaluated size, wall thickness, location of the mass, presence or absence of internal septation, homogeneity of the internal components of each compartment, calcification or fat within the mass, and ancillary findings in adjacent structures. RESULTS: Severe symptoms (chest pain or hemoptysis) were more commonly found in ruptured (71%) than in unruptured tumors. All ruptured mediastinal teratomas had a tendency to display inhomogeneity of the internal components, whereas 90% of unruptured masses showed homogeneous densities of internal components in each compartment of the mass. Ancillary CT findings in ruptured tumors included fat-containing masses in adjacent lung parenchyma in two patients, consolidation or atelectasis in the adjacent lung in three patients, pericardial effusion in one patient, and pleural effusion in four patients. CONCLUSION: In cases of mediastinal teratoma, CT findings of inhomogeneity of the internal components and changes in the adjacent lung parenchyma, pleura, or pericardium can be used as signs of tumor rupture.
abstract_ja: 目的: CTを用いて破裂例と非破裂例の縦隔奇形腫を鑑別すること。材料と方法: 手術で切除された縦隔奇形腫17例のCT所見を後方視的に検討した。術前に破裂が認められた症例が手術中に7例見つかった。破裂例と非破裂例の臨床症状とCT所見を比較した。CTでは腫瘤の大きさ、壁の厚さ、部位、内部の隔壁の有無、各区画内部成分の均一性、腫瘤内の石灰化または脂肪、隣接構造の付随所見を評価した。結果: 重篤な症状(胸痛や喀血)は、非破裂例(71%)よりも破裂例で多く認められた。破裂例はすべて内部成分の不均一さを示す傾向があり、非破裂例の90%は各区画の内部成分の濃度が均一であった。破裂例の付随所見には、隣接肺実質の脂肪を含む腫瘤が2例、隣接肺の浸潤影または無気肺が3例、心膜液貯留が1例、胸水貯留が4例含まれていた。結論: 縦隔奇形腫では、内部成分の不均一性や隣接する肺実質、胸膜、心膜の変化を腫瘍破裂の徴候として用いることができる。
